title: National Taichung Theater
geometryBasis: The four-corner OSM building envelope, 2024 Qualla photograph, original elevation field, 32-metre main enclosure and 37.7-metre overall height from project documents.
sectionBasis: A straight theater envelope with continuously curved, partly glazed plaza apertures, a recessed entrance and a roof garden. The nominal main shell is 32 metres, with total high point 37.7 metres.
limitations: The model represents the March 2024 exterior, including the plaza elevation, entrance shell and rooftop garden volume. Interior theater spaces and the plaza’s temporary installations are outside scope.
The exact image establishes the glazing patterns, colors and white folds of the main frontage. Rear and side apertures, roof gardens, and shell depth are approximate.
The mapped building defines the footprint. The public elevation model is retained and local grade remains approximate.
